response.intro: This release extracts the registry code into a new @shadcn/registry package and adds extensive community registry entries. It also introduces OIDC configuration, updates next.js handling for forwarded headers, and improves reduced‑motion behavior. Several fixes address SVG viewBox handling, logo rendering, and component dependencies.

sections.prose: Corrections to SVG handling, component behavior, and configuration.

response.intro: This release adds support for OIDC authentication and introduces a new registry API package. It also expands the list of available UI registries and improves visual and accessibility details.
